subject: Report section
notes: A REPORT SECTION is accepted in a program and a function (driven: LC 2/3) and in a factory and an instance (acceptance only; their methods reference no object-local report-name or counter, per §8.4.6.2.2/§8.4.6.2.5). It is refused in a method (1519) and in an interface's method prototype (§10.6.2 4) e), 2272).
